name: systemd-analyze
description: Analyze systemd boot performance, service dependencies, and unit timing — visualize blame, critical chain, and generate SVG plots of the boot sequence.

install_steps: Pre-installed on all systemd-based Linux distributions (Fedora, Debian, Ubuntu, Arch, etc.)
install_guidance.note: Part of the systemd package. Available on any modern Linux distribution using systemd as init system.
